acceptance_summary.compile_command: gcc -O3 -march=native -Wall -Werror core_pipeline.c crypto_core.c mesh_adapter.c bench_recursive_crypto.c -lcrypto -lm -o bench_recursive_crypto

BM-01.metric: invariant check throughput ns/check over runtime-populated 128-state valid-transition bank

BM-04.metric: synthetic +/-50 ms jitter window and median RTT triangle-consistency heuristic
BM-04.claim_ceiling: RTT triangle consistency is a sanity heuristic and is not a physical speed-of-light distance proof

BM-06.metric: caller-owned designated key buffers are all-zero after aura_secure_bzero
BM-06.claim_ceiling: does not establish absence of transient copies in provider internals, CPU registers, caches, swap, DMA-visible memory, or physical remanence

hdc_assurance.implementation: AVX2 vectorized complex phasor bind/unbind plus FST pad XOR

pipeline_assurance.blake3_scope: single-block <=64-byte implementation; Stage-10 derivation input is fixed at 60 bytes

delta_h_vs_seed_refresh.reason: refreshing the embedded 48-bit cryptographic seed slice normally changes more than one bit
delta_h_vs_seed_refresh.staged_resolution: verify the one-bit control transition first, then derive and commit the new session-seed slice as post-invariant Stage-10 rebase material

mesh_assurance.transport_scope: deterministic loopback UDP bind/port rotation only

gate_b_required_action: Do not promote. Either optimize/redefine BM-01 under an agreed measurement protocol and rerun, or explicitly revise the <1.5 ns acceptance criterion. Separately review the atomic Delta-H=1 versus embedded seed-refresh interaction before canonicalization.
